title: Cloud Storage Bucket Misconfiguration
summary: A routine review finds that a cloud storage bucket was briefly configured for public read access, and the audit log shows anonymous requests during that window.
learning_goals: Apply the shared-responsibility model to a cloud misconfiguration
Distinguish evidence of possible exposure from evidence of confirmed data exfiltration
Recommend proportionate response given genuinely incomplete evidence
initial_situation: A quarterly access review finds that reports-bucket allowed public read access for several hours and that anonymous requests occurred during that window.

injects.message: Security team confirms the public ACL was live for roughly seven hours before being reverted.
The audit log shows anonymous GetObject and ListBucket calls, but no unusually large transfer volumes are recorded.
Leadership asks whether this must be reported as a confirmed data breach.

default_objective: Determine what the audit log does and does not confirm about data exposure, and recommend next steps and reporting obligations based only on the evidence available.
